name: mermaid-render
description: Draws Mermaid diagrams in Claude Code's terminal replies as colored Unicode box art; wide ones scroll inside a box in the reply.

steer.title: Ask Claude to write diagrams as Mermaid
steer.description: Adds a short system-prompt section asking Claude to draw diagrams as mermaid blocks instead of ASCII art.

check.title: Check Claude's diagrams and have it fix mistakes
check.description: Checks each diagram in Claude's replies for lines Mermaid rejects or the terminal would draw wrong, notes them under the diagram, and sends Claude back once to fix them.
